held_clip_reading.basis: crates/hsk-studio-pulse/src/retime.rs module docs: a held clip answers one frame at every timeline tick, clip_source_at reads it; a hold applies to the named clip, not its link group; a linked audio partner keeps playing its own window
held_clip_reading.kept: Link in place, group move, unlink, the toggle (trim and razor; the right half keeps the hold and has no link) and alignment by in or out point read and write timeline positions only. The hold record does not change, no RetimeRecord is emitted, and clip_source_at shows the held frame at the new position. A moved held clip's undo is exact.
held_clip_reading.refused: Timecode and marker read a source position, and a held clip plays none, so no tick of it can carry that position. sync_hold_unsupported names the clip, as the anchor or a member, before its timecode or marker is looked at. plan_clear_frame_hold is the way out, and the test proves the marker basis then works.

declared_readings: In point = timeline start, out point = timeline end; a clip moves on its own track, later clips do not ripple, sync-locked tracks do not shift.

Merge anchors on its one video clip, so a merge needs exactly one video clip and at least one audio clip (STU-VID-029 'a video clip and the audio clips'). Two video clips refuse merge_no_av_pair. Synchronize takes any kinds and a named anchor.
Timecode needs unit speed, the same rate and drop-frame mode as the anchor, and a shared timecode span. Cross-rate label comparison is refused, not guessed.
Marker = the clip marker of the requested name inside the playing window, through the clip speed. A position between ticks rounds down, as marker_span does.
A link written in place leaves transitions alone; an aligning unit lists the ones it ends in dropped_transitions, even when no clip ends up moving.
A razor under Suspended leaves the right half unlinked; plan_unlink also works on a group that breaks the one-clip-per-track reading, as the way out of it.

waveform.found: no audio alignment correlator in pulse's dependencies (accord, folio, observe, score). Score src/restore.rs has autocorrelation for an AR fit. Pigment src/track_math.rs has image-window cross-correlation and is not a pulse dependency. Harness-view src/view/waveform.rs is display. Repeated at 27cba13b with git grep -ilE 'cross.?correl|normalized.?correl|xcorr|autocorrel': hits only develop tests, pigment track_math.rs and score restore.rs; score's waveform-named modules are editing and display.

Tie and no-match need typed refusals.
